title: ISAAC Draft (authoring format — NOT an ISAAC record)
description: The pre-export working format. Scalar fields carry an evidence envelope so no value is finalized without a source. `isaac export` transforms a draft into the official ISAAC record shape (schema/isaac_record_v1.json) and moves evidence to a sidecar. This schema validates draft STRUCTURE only; the no-guessing rules are enforced by src/isaac_records/draft_validator.py, and vocabulary/units are enforced by the official schema post-transform.

fields.description: Map of dotted official JSON-path → field envelope. Scalars only.

pending.description: Deterministic-pipeline blockers that need more input before export (the /isaac-complete question set): a sha256 for each asset candidate, the reduced spectrum for measurement.series, and at least one descriptor. Draft-only bookkeeping; never becomes a record field.

implicit.description: Sidecar-only inferences (e.g. absorbing element from formula). Never become record fields.

unit.description: Informational in drafts; official records encode units in key names.
